constraints: Applies only to enterable objects: hierarchical lists, list box columns, subforms (object name only), and list forms displayed via DISPLAY SELECTION/MODIFY SELECTION.
If used on an enterable object that is not a list, it behaves the same as GOTO OBJECT.
Does nothing if the target list/array is empty or invisible; if the list/array is not enterable, it only selects the item without entering edit mode.

overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether a leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a Table/Variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two overloads.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, 'object' below is an object name (pass a string); if omitted, 'object' is a Table or Variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if '*' passed) or Table/variable reference (if '*' omitted)

params.name: item
params.description: Position of the item (hierarchical list) or row number (list box column/list form/subform); if omitted, applies to the current item, or the first item if there is no current item.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Switches the current (or specified) item of the given enterable list-like object into edit mode, replacing its content on the next keystroke.
